cohort: 58 singleton births from women who underwent RYGB, 58 singleton births from women with a prepregnancy BMI < 35 kg/m(2), and 58 singleton births from women with a prepregnancy BMI ≥ 35 kg/m(2)
finding: Neonates born to women who underwent RYGB had lower birth weights compared to those born to women in both control groups, irrespective of GWG.
mod_finding: Pregnancies post-RYGB showed a higher prevalence of cesarean section than CG1.
gest_age: Gestational age was similar between the groups.
birth_weight: Neonates born after RYGB presented lower birth weight compared to CG1 and CG2
